hooks.name: Auto Commit and Push on Save
hooks.description: Automatically commits and pushes all changes to GitHub whenever a file is saved in the workspace

action.command: cd /Users/chyngyzoskonbaev/Hackachusetts && git add -A && git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "auto: save $(date '+%H:%M:%S')" && git push origin main 2>&1 || true
